about: The reference shelf: clips the owner approved by ear (2026-11-25 element deck, round 8, Felt and pulse). Paths starting with ~ are in the owner's Documents; others are relative to this folder. 'readings' are the note-based numbers the mix analysis measured on 2026-11-25 (stems and note logs re-rendered layer by layer; nothing here was heard by the analyst). Audio readings are measured by render.sh --shelf. Numbers to read next to a new piece, never targets.
